title: Egnyte Launches Context Layer to Power More Accurate AI Agents Across Business Workflows
author: Unknown
description: Egnyte introduced the Context Layer, a business context foundation that maps relationships across content, people, projects, and systems to enable AI agents to work more efficiently and accurately. The platform eliminates redundant processing, reduces costs, and maintains security governance. New capabilities for AEC firms will be demonstrated at Autodesk University, including auto-classification, AI actions in project centers, and integration with Autodesk systems.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Autodesk is featured as a strategic partner with deep integration capabilities through the new Autodesk Forma Data Management AI Connector. The partnership demonstrates Autodesk's ecosystem strength and positions its tools as central to AEC workflows powered by AI.

title: EGHT or ADSK: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
author: Na
description: In a comparison of two Internet-Software sector stocks, 8x8 (EGHT) emerges as the superior value option compared to Autodesk (ADSK). EGHT has a stronger Zacks Rank (#2 Buy vs #3 Hold), better valuation metrics including a forward P/E of 5.18 versus 16.81, and a Value grade of A compared to ADSK's C grade.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: EGHT demonstrates stronger fundamentals with a #2 Buy Zacks Rank, significantly lower forward P/E ratio (5.18), lower PEG ratio (0.73), lower P/B ratio (1.76), and an A Value grade, making it more attractive to value investors.

ADSK has a #3 Hold Zacks Rank with higher valuation multiples (forward P/E of 16.81, PEG of 1.07, P/B of 13.12) and a C Value grade, indicating it is less attractive as a value investment compared to EGHT.

title: AI in Construction Market Surges to USD 53.32 Billion by 2035, at 26.38% CAGR – Report by SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider
description: The global AI in construction market is projected to grow from USD 5.13 billion in 2025 to USD 53.32 billion by 2035, driven by labor shortages, cost overruns, and adoption of AI-powered planning, safety monitoring, and robotics. North America leads the market with the U.S. accounting for 83.7% of regional revenue, while Asia Pacific emerges as the fastest-growing region. Software solutions dominate with 57.42% market share, while robotics and safety management applications show the fastest growth rates.

title: ICBA and Global eTraining Launch Construction Technology Training Initiative to Upskill Canadian Contractors
author: Not Specified
description: The Independent Contractors and Businesses Association (ICBA) has partnered with Global eTraining to launch a construction technology training initiative providing Canadian contractors with on-demand access to hundreds of software courses covering Autodesk applications, BIM tools, and other construction technologies through ICBA's learning management system.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Autodesk applications (Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, Civil 3D) are prominently featured in the training initiative, which increases user adoption and proficiency with Autodesk products among Canadian contractors.

title: Autodesk (ADSK) Reports Q2 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
author: Na
description: Autodesk reported $2.05 billion in revenue for Q3 2026, up 16.1% year-over-year and exceeding the consensus estimate of $2.01 billion. EPS came in at $3.30 versus $3.12 expected, representing a 5.77% surprise. The company showed strong performance across key metrics including subscription revenue growth of 17.7% and solid performance in major product families like AECO and AutoCAD. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Autodesk exceeded both revenue and EPS expectations with strong year-over-year growth of 16.1% in revenue and 25.95% in EPS. Subscription revenue grew 17.7% YoY, and the company beat analyst estimates across multiple product families including AECO (+17.2%) and AutoCAD (+13.6%). The stock has outperformed the S&P 500 over the past month (+3.9% vs +3.7%).
